subject: Lexical elements
notes: Rule: 'Except when appearing in a picture character-string, the COBOL characters right parenthesis and left parenthesis are separators. Except in pseudo-text, parentheses may appear only in balanced pairs ... delimiting subscripts, a list of function or method arguments, a reference modifier, arithmetic or boolean expressions, or conditions.' (cite.py --check 8.3.5 OK §8.3.5 4)). Picture exception: PICMODE captures `X(5)`/`9(3)` as one PIC_STRING. Balance/position enforced by the parser: probes probe/lexical-elements/unbalparen.cob `COMPUTE N = (M + 1.` rejected; extraparen.cob `(M + 1))` rejected; parendisp.cob `DISPLAY (A).` rejected; subsp.cob `E (2)` / `E( 3 )` accepted. Pseudo-text exception: replparen.cob `REPLACE ==ZZ(== BY ==DISPLAY ==.` then `ZZ( "OK".` compiles and prints OK.
